faq.q: Why are barcodes black and white?
faq.a: The scanner needs strong contrast between bars that absorb its light and gaps that reflect it. Because scanners use red light, red ink reflects like white and cannot be used for the bars.
asks: Can a barcode be any colour?

faq.q: How are bar widths turned into numbers?
faq.a: In an EAN-13 shop barcode, each digit takes up seven narrow units, split into two bars and two spaces of different widths. The decoder measures the widths and matches them to a table of patterns for each digit.
asks: What do the lines on a barcode mean?

faq.q: What is a barcode check digit?
faq.a: The last digit is calculated from all the others using a simple weighted sum. The scanner repeats the sum; if it does not match the check digit, it knows the read went wrong and tries again.
asks: How does a scanner know it read the barcode right?

faq.q: Does a barcode store the price?
faq.a: No. A shop barcode stores a product number. The till looks that number up in the shop's database to find the name and today's price, so prices can change without new labels.
asks: Where does the price come from when you scan something?

faq.q: Why can a scanner read a barcode upside down?
faq.a: The left and right halves of the code use different bar patterns, and guard bars mark the start, middle and end. The decoder can tell which way round it is reading and flips the result if needed.
asks: Does it matter which way you scan a barcode?

facts: The first product scanned with a UPC barcode at a shop till was a pack of Wrigley's chewing gum in Troy, Ohio, on 26 June 1974.
An EAN-13 barcode has 13 digits, and the last one is a check digit.

quiz.say: Why can't barcode bars be printed in red ink?

options.show: Scanners use red light, so red looks like white
options.say: Scanners use red light, so red looks like white

quiz.why: A red scanner beam reflects off red ink just as it does off white paper, so the bars vanish.

wrong.1: Cost is not the reason; the problem is contrast under red light.
wrong.2: Smudging is not the issue; red bars are invisible to a red scanner.
